mapper.select: SELECT ips.id pool_status_id ,ips.adjust_log_id ,ips.security_code ,ips.security_short_name ,ips.security_type old_security_type ,si.security_type new_security_type FROM ip_pool_status ips INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.wind_code = ips.security_code INNER JOIN dict_security_type old_type ON old_type.security_type = ips.security_type AND old_type.category_type = 'bond' AND old_type.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN dict_security_type new_type ON new_type.security_type = si.security_type AND new_type.category_type = 'bond' AND new_type.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.security_type != si.security_type ORDER BY ips.id ASC

SELECT ips.id pool_status_id ,ips.adjust_log_id ,ips.security_code ,ips.security_short_name ,ips.security_type old_security_type ,si.security_type new_security_type FROM ip_pool_status_crmw ips INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.wind_code = ips.security_code INNER JOIN dict_security_type old_type ON old_type.security_type = ips.security_type AND old_type.category_type = 'bond' AND old_type.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN dict_security_type new_type ON new_type.security_type = si.security_type AND new_type.category_type = 'bond' AND new_type.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.security_type != si.security_type ORDER BY ips.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ip_adjust_log al SET security_type = ( SELECT si.security_type FROM rrs_securityinfo si WHERE si.wind_code = al.security_code ) , updt_time = #{updateTime} WHERE al.is_deleted = 0 AND al.audit_status = '20' AND al.security_type != ( SELECT si.security_type FROM rrs_securityinfo si WHERE si.wind_code = al.security_code AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dict_security_type new_type WHERE new_type.security_type = si.security_type AND new_type.category_type = 'bond' AND new_type.is_deleted = 0 ) )
